guarantees.claim: u_prim_buf_in drives in_buf with a buffered copy of in.

assumptions.claim: The width parameter NumInBufBits matches the bit-widths of in and in_buf.
assumptions.risk: Width mismatch may cause truncation or zero-extension, corrupting data before use.

uncertain_points.claim: Declared signals incr, incr_err, mr_err, ctr_i_slice have no driver in this chunk; their correct operation depends on other processes.
uncertain_points.cond: when these signals are used in downstream logic
uncertain_points.risk: Undriven signals may propagate X's, leading to simulation mismatches or synthesis warnings.

uncertain_points.claim: prim_buf may introduce either combinational or registered delays; its exact timing is not specified, affecting when in_buf is valid.
uncertain_points.risk: If the buffer is not combinational, downstream sampling may capture stale values, breaking FSM timing assumptions.
